answer: A willow bends but does not break: an agent economy resists fake identities by bonding every identity to a refundable stake locked in escrow. Any peer may whisper a challenge, forcing the challenged identity to redo its claimed work in public before a deadline. Success returns the stake untouched; failure or silence slashes it into the commons. A cedar grows slowly, and so does trust: stake weight rises only with verified work history. One fake identity costs one full stake, a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, while an honest agent pays nothing but its time.
